{{Short description|Czech mathematician}}
'''Bohuslav Diviš''' (December 20, 1942 – July 26, 1976) was a Czech mathematician, who worked in the field of [[number theory]].<ref name=jnt77>[https://www.sciencedirect.com/journal/journal-of-number-theory/vol/9/issue/1 Journal of Number Theory vol.9 Issue 1, 1977]</ref><ref>{{MathGenealogy|54447}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://trustees.osu.edu/assets/files/minutes/Archive%20minutes/1976-1978.pdf |title=Record of Proceedings of the Board of Trustees of the Ohio State University 1976-77 |access-date=2016-02-02 |archive-date=2016-02-02 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160202221758/http://trustees.osu.edu/assets/files/minutes/Archive%20minutes/1976-1978.pdf |url-status=live}}</ref>

==Biography==
Bohuslav Diviš was born on December 20, 1942, in [[Prague]]. He won the Czechoslovak and [[International Mathematical Olympiad]] in 1959 and then studied mathematics at [[Charles University]] in Prague (as a student of [[Vojtěch Jarník]]). He wrote his thesis in 1966 and his doctorate in 1969 with a thesis on "superlattice points in multidimensional ellipsoids" at the [[Heidelberg University]] under [[Peter Roquette]].<ref name=jnt77/>

In 1970 Diviš became assistant professor at [[Ohio State University]] (USA), and after 1973 an associate professor. He authored about 20 scientific articles.

On July 26, 1976, during a conference visit to [[Illinois State University]] in [[Normal, Illinois]], he died of heart failure at the age of 33.

== Literature ==
* B. Diviš: ''On the sums of continued fractions'', [[Acta Arithmetica]] '''22''', 157–173, 1973
* ders.: ''Lattice point theory of irrational ellipsoids with an arbitrary center'', Monatsh. Math. '''83''', 279–307,  1977
* ders.: ''Ω-estimates in lattice point theory'', Acta Arithmetica '''35''', 247–258, 1979
* F. Fricker: ''Einführung in die Gitterpunktlehre'', Birkhäuser, 1982
